turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. We will go through three questions.
Tell me about a project you delivered under a tight deadline.

Um, so the project was a billing migration for a small team. Basically we had two months to move customers off an old system. I, uh, split the work into three stages and wrote a checklist for each one. We moved ten percent of accounts first, then half, then everyone. We finished a week early and support tickets stayed flat.

The hardest part was, you know, the data cleanup. Many records were duplicated, so I wrote a script and checked a sample by hand. It was, like, slow work but it caught errors early. Actually, the sample check found about forty bad rows.
What would you say your biggest strength is, and also

Er, I would say my biggest strength is planning. I like to write things down before I start. I mean, with the migration, the checklist sort of kept everyone calm. Um, my weakness is that I take on too much, so I now ask for help earlier and I track my hours each week.
Where do you want to grow next?
I want to grow into leading a team. I am kind of new to managing people, so I would start by asking questions. Basically, I would learn how the team works first and then suggest small changes.
Thank you, that is all the time we have.
